summary: Form-associated range slider with a dithered fill and a lens for a thumb that magnifies the dots beneath it.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current value, clamped to `min`–`max` and snapped to `step`. Defaults to `min`. Observed and reflected back with the snapped value; changes from code fire no events.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Step size. Its decimal places also set the displayed precision. Values at or below 0 fall back to 1. Observed.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Text before the displayed value, for example `$`. Observed.

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Text after the displayed value, for example ` ms`. Observed.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label; also names the slider through `aria-labelledby`. Observed.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Presence attribute. Disables the slider; a disabled ancestor `<fieldset>` does the same.

events.name: input
events.description: Fires on every value change from a drag or key press. Not fired when `value` is set from code.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires on pointer release and after each key press that changed the value.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value. Setting it clamps, snaps and reflects to the attribute without firing events.

properties.name: frac
properties.description: Position of the value in the range, 0 to 1.

keyboard.action: Change by a tenth of the range.

accessibility: The track has `role="slider"` and `tabindex="0"` and is named by the label through `aria-labelledby`.
Sets `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuetext` (formatted with `prefix` and `unit`) on every change.
Pressing on the track focuses it.
motion: With reduced motion the thumb jumps to the value without the spring and the value text swaps without rolling.
form: Submits the current value as a string under `name`. No validation. Form reset restores the value from the first connect; `disabled` or a disabled fieldset takes the slider out of the tab order.
notes: All attributes are observed. New bounds or a new `step` re-clamp and re-snap the value without events and update the end labels under the track.
